title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
abstract: arXiv:2610.15056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can post-edit ASR by using linguistic context to compare N-best hypotheses and rewrite the transcript when needed, often improving WER without retraining the recognizer. However, prompt-only correction is brittle: it may over-edit when top-1 is correct and hallucinate when the reference is absent, and often needs very large models. We propose oracle-guided fine-tuning that turns N-best lists into supervision via three curated pools: corrections (reference in the list but not top-1) to teach selection, regularizers (top-1 correct) to discourage unnecessary rewrites, and hard negatives (reference absent) to suppress hallucination. translated_title: 选择或重写：基于N最佳假设的生成式语音识别后编辑的Oracle引导微调
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以通过利用语言上下文来比较N最佳假设并在需要时重写转录文本，从而对语音识别（ASR）结果进行后编辑，通常无需重新训练识别器即可改善词错误率（WER）。然而，仅依靠提示词的纠正是脆弱的：当top-1假设正确时它可能过度编辑，当参考文本不在候选列表中时它可能产生幻觉，而且往往需要非常大的模型。我们提出oracle引导的微调方法，通过三个精心构建的数据池将N最佳列表转化为监督信号：纠正池（参考文本在列表中但不在top-1）用于教授选择能力，正则化池（top-1正确）用于抑制不必要的重写，难负例池（参考文本不在列表中）用于抑制幻觉。在这种数据上进行微调，比随机子集微调能更有效地监督模型学习“选择或重写”的混合策略，在专有数据集上从大约3B参数规模开始获得最明显的收益，但在CommonVoice上的结果较不明确，这种分歧表明（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出oracle引导微调方法，通过构建纠正、正则化和难负例三类数据池，将N最佳假设列表转化为监督信号，教会大语言模型学习“选择或重写”的混合策略来后编辑ASR结果，从而有效减少过度编辑和幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes oracle-guided fine-tuning that converts N-best lists into supervision via three curated pools (corrections, regularizers, hard negatives), teaching LLMs a hybrid select-or-rewrite policy for ASR post-editing that reduces over-editing and hallucination.
